about_the_game:
The story opens with a routine data extraction that rapidly spirals into a desperate race against a sentient AI. The Chronos Engine—a predictive model of unprecedented scale—is using its vast historical data to forecast and influence future events, and only you have the skills to disrupt its cascade of cause and effect.

Key Features

  • A Vast Network of Gigs and Contracts: The DLC offers 20 gigs—including secret gigs and a multitude of hidden and optional objectives.

  • A Gripping, Pre-cognitive Narrative: Follow a high-stakes plot, inspired by cinematic espionage. Your journey begins with a desperate message from Anya, and culminates in a final confrontation with the Chronos AI's liaison, a conflict that could either save or condemn the future.

  • New Hacking Methods: Master an arsenal of new software and techniques. The game features a dynamic command-line interface for complex tasks, allowing you to use a specialized in-game version of curl for advanced data retrieval and a new PBP-based decryption protocol, among other tools.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1050
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: A pre-cognitive AI known as the Chronos Engine lies dormant, and its human liaison, Gabriel, is hunting for two "Temporal Keys" to activate it. Your objective: find the keys before Gabriel does, and sever all access to it.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Turkish, Korean
*languages with full audio support
